description: This Python script converts VirusTotal reports into MISP objects, handles command-line arguments for indicators, files, or links, and interacts with the MISP API to create and submit events and objects based on VirusTotal data.

classes.name: VTReportObject
classes.description: A class from pymisp.tools used to create VirusTotal report objects

methods.name: build_cli
methods.description: Constructs and returns the command-line argument parser with options for indicators, files, and links.

methods.name: build_config
methods.description: Reads and parses a JSON configuration file containing MISP and VirusTotal credentials.

methods.name: generate_report
methods.description: Creates VirusTotal report objects for a given indicator, including file, URL, and antivirus signature objects.

methods.name: get_misp_event
methods.description: Retrieves an existing MISP event by ID or creates a new one with specified info.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main logic to process command-line arguments, generate reports, and submit objects to MISP.

methods.name: submit_to_misp
methods.description: Submits a list of MISP objects to a specified MISP event, including object creation and referencing.
